biotools.summary: YOLO-Punica is a faster and lighter version of YOLOv8n designed for real-time pomegranate fruit development detection. It incorporates dual-path downsampling and cross-scale feature fusion modules to improve accuracy and efficiency, particularly for resource-constrained environments.
